extension.summary: Watch Twitch streams and chat from Kodi
extension.description: View Twitch streams using Kodi's own playback, with a paired IRC chat view. Not designed for chatting back to streamers - a second way to consume streamer-generated content.
extension.news: v0.11.1: Fixed the Website Token setting (for ad-free/subscriber-perk playback) never appearing in Settings > General - an empty default value made Kodi silently drop it from the settings dialog. Also fixed the same bug for an internal setting. Both now show up and work correctly. v0.11.0: New "Show offline channels on Home" setting (Settings > General, off by default) - turn it on to bring offline followed channels back into Home's list, after the live ones. v0.10.0: Chat now shows automatically as a right-side overlay while a stream plays (Settings > General > Chat display mode, "overlay" or "both"). Connects anonymously to Twitch IRC, auto-reconnects on drops, and closes itself when the stream stops, ends, or errors out. Standalone full-screen chat and the picture-in-picture windowed-video layout are still to come. v0.9.0: Fixed window flicker and revert bug when opening Discover screen by adding a safe control delay and using xbmc.sleep(). Improved error handling for missing UI controls across Home and Discover windows. v0.8.1: Fixed the real cause of "stuck on login/gets a new code every time" - Home's skin defaultcontrol targeted the (empty until data loads) channel list, which made Kodi's window manager silently abort activating Home and revert to Login whenever Home wasn't the very first window shown in a session. No script-side fix could catch this since it happens before Python even runs. Same root cause and fix as Discover's earlier "flashes then reverts" bug. v0.8.0: Discover's search can now search by game/category, not just channel name - a toggle button next to the search box switches modes ("Searching: Channels" / "Searching: Games"). Searching a game (e.g. "warships") finds the best-matching category and lists its live streams. v0.7.2: Fixed streams continuing to play in the background after pressing Back - Kodi's own fullscreen-video Back only exits the fullscreen view, it doesn't stop playback. Home and Discover's Back now stop an active stream instead of closing the whole addon out from under it. v0.7.1: Added a Settings button on Home - opens Kodi's native addon settings dialog directly (no more digging through Add-ons browser context menus), and reloads Home afterward so a newly pasted Website Token takes effect immediately. v0.7.0: New optional "Website Token" setting (Settings > General) - paste your twitch.tv browser session's auth-token cookie to unlock ad-free/subscriber-perk playback and get the followed-games filter row actually working (it silently 401'd before, same root cause as the playback bug). Leave it empty to keep the default anonymous/public behavior. v0.6.5: Fixed playback always failing with "session expired": Twitch's internal GraphQL API permanently rejects any real user OAuth token from a non-Twitch client_id, so no refresh could ever fix it. Playback token requests are now made anonymously, which Twitch serves fine for public live streams. v0.6.4: Fixed Login screen restarting the device-code flow (new code shown) after a successful login, when Kodi re-fires the window's init on an already-completed login. v0.6.3: Token refresh failures are now logged with the actual reason (network error, HTTP status, bad response body) instead of silently forcing a re-login with no diagnostic trail. v0.6.2: Fixed Home's focus landing on a random button (Relogin/Discover) right after load - the skin's defaultcontrol targeted the channel list before it had items, so Kodi's focus fallback could pick a button; a stray keypress there would silently trigger unwanted navigation. v0.6.1: Fixed login screen ending the whole script on successful login instead of continuing to Home - required reopening the addon manually every time the session expired. v0.6.0: Real stream playback via inputstream.adaptive; clicking a live channel in Home or Discover now plays it. v0.5.0: Discover screen (browse by game, channel search); fixed window navigation killing the script; fixed unreachable skin controls. v0.4.0: followed-games filter row on Home. v0.3.0: Home screen (followed channels, thumbnails, token refresh). v0.2.0: Twitch device-code login. v0.1.0: initial addon scaffold.
